subject: english
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

a short section (as of a book) that leads to or explains the main part.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Foreword**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Foreword"** means a short section** (as of a book) **that leads to or explains the main part. (प्रस्तावना)

 
 
• **Example: **The author's friend wrote the **foreword** for his latest novel, introducing the themes and background of the story.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Foreword**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Conclusion** (निष्कर्ष): The end or finish of an event, process, or text.

 
 
• **Example:** The conclusion of the research paper summarized the key findings and implications.
 
 
 
• **Postscript** (परिशिष्ट): An additional remark at the end of a letter, after the signature.
 
 
• **Example:** She added a postscript to her letter to mention an important detail she had forgotten.
 
 
 
• **Paraphrase** (मूलार्थ को अन्य शब्दों में कहना): Expressing the meaning of something written or spoken using different words, especially to achieve greater clarity.
 
 
• **Example:** The teacher asked the students to paraphrase the poem to show their understanding.
 
 

39:Tb65,

The correct answer is: **Option 1**.
